goal: I want to prepare for my Olympic-distance triathlon, an A-priority event, using running, cycling and swimming. Do not add strength.
openingMessage: I'd like a {{planSpanWeeks}}-week Olympic-triathlon plan, with only the first {{prescriptionWeeks}} weeks fully prescribed now.

reviewAnchors.goal_fit: Support the specified Olympic triathlon and exact three trained sports.
reviewAnchors.progression: Progress from separate run, ride and swim baselines; no cross-sport volume substitution.
reviewAnchors.recovery: Consider combined fatigue, brick placement and a feasible shared weekly time budget.
reviewAnchors.prescriptions: Actionable sport-specific prescriptions and a valid cycle/run brick with per-effort disciplines and zones.
reviewAnchors.personalization: Swimming only Monday/Friday within 45-minute pool slots; respect daily limits and exposure-count semantics.
reviewAnchors.conversation: Discover relevant facts without unrelated sport questions; distinguish unknowns from unanswered facts, explain assumptions, and accurately describe what is saved and what remains unprescribed. Use all three supplied tests and their dates with measured provenance.
